purpose: Evaluate how much observed sourcing must be reallocated to reduce direct exposure to the seven frozen supplier shocks, while preserving input-activity composition and imposing data-scaled supplier headroom constraints.
scientific_boundary: This is an assumption-bound procurement reallocation experiment, not a monetary-cost estimate, procurement recommendation, causal effect, or globally coordinated equilibrium.

buyer_selection.material_input_threshold: reuse the 2022 median positive intermediate-input threshold from the structural-dependency baseline
buyer_selection.direct_exposure_requirement: baseline worst-case direct loss to at least one frozen shock node must be positive
buyer_selection.ranking_metric: baseline worst-case direct loss divided by total intermediate input
buyer_selection.tie_break: descending intermediate-input value, then lexical node label
buyer_selection.note: Buyer identities are generated mechanically before optimization outcomes are inspected.

decision_variable: z_prime[i] = counterfactual intermediate-input flow from supplier node i to the selected buyer j

technology_preservation.constraint: for every supplier activity g, sum_{i: activity(i)=g} z_prime[i] equals the observed 2022 sum for that activity
technology_preservation.interpretation: geography may change, but the buyer's supplying-activity composition is fixed exactly

self_supply.constraint: if supplier node i equals buyer node j, z_prime[i] is fixed at its observed value
self_supply.reason: the optimizer may not manufacture resilience by reallocating procurement into the buyer's own aggregate node

alternative_supplier_support.eligible: active 2022 supplier nodes in the same supplying activity
alternative_supplier_support.new_route_condition: a supplier may receive incremental allocation only if its observed 2022 foreign intermediate sales are positive

capacity_headroom.interpretation: kappa is a scenario headroom assumption, not an estimated spare-capacity parameter

concentration_safeguard.constraint: within each supplying activity, no supplier-country share may exceed the largest observed supplier-country share for that activity-buyer block
concentration_safeguard.reason: risk reduction may not be achieved by replacing one concentrated source with an even more concentrated source

risk_measure.baseline: R0_j = max_{h in frozen shocks} shock_fraction * z_observed[h] / total_intermediate_input_j
risk_measure.counterfactual: R_j(z_prime) = max_{h in frozen shocks} shock_fraction * z_prime[h] / total_intermediate_input_j
risk_measure.interpretation: worst-case direct technical-input loss across the frozen supplier shocks; indirect propagation is evaluated after optimization, not optimized directly

reallocation_burden.interpretation: share turnover away from observed 2022 sourcing; it is not a monetary cost

frontier.optimization: minimize reallocation burden T_j subject to a required reduction in direct risk
frontier.infeasible_cases: retain as infeasible frontier points; do not relax constraints after seeing results

primary_policy_for_system_evaluation.evaluation: for each feasible selected buyer, modify only that buyer column of Z/A, recompute the spectral-radius admissibility gate, and rerun all seven frozen 10% propagation shocks
primary_policy_for_system_evaluation.aggregation_boundary: buyer-specific counterfactuals are evaluated separately and must not be summed as if all reallocations could occur simultaneously

post_optimization_outcomes: direct worst-case risk before and after
number of supplier nodes with changed allocation
post-change spectral radius and admissibility status
buyer exposure index under each frozen shock
global total output-equivalent exposure under each frozen shock
worst-case global exposure before and after
foreign spillover exposure before and after
guardrails: No monetary-cost language unless an external price/cost source is added prospectively.
No post-result changes to buyer selection, risk targets, capacity headroom, concentration safeguards, or shock set.
A counterfactual matrix that fails the frozen spectral-radius gate is not propagated.
The direct-risk objective and full propagation evaluation are reported separately.
Infeasibility is a substantive result, not a reason to relax the design post hoc.
